verdict.rationale: Tavily's own materials describe it as 'real-time web access' and 'real-time web search', which speaks to the freshness half of the story. However, the documented search parameters in the pack (domain prefer/restrict, safe_search, language, latency/relevance depth) include no date-range or recency filter. Missing for 10: documented date-range/start-end date parameters, recency/time-window filters, evidence of index update frequency, independent or hands-on corroboration of result freshness.
